```{r, echo = F, message = F}
ICBdy    = read.csv(here("Raw Data", "ICB data", "icbdy_v15.csv"))
ICB_int  = read.csv(here("Raw Data", "ICB data", "icb_interveners_prompt_run_20241122.csv"))
ICB2     = read.csv(here("Raw Data", "ICB data", "icb2v15.csv"))
ICB1     = read.csv(here("Raw Data", "ICB data", "icb1v15.csv"))
```

This R code modifies the Gleditsch and Ward country codes (gwncode) based on the Correlates of War (COW) country codes (COWcode) in VDEM dataset.

```{r, echo = F}
VDEM_simple = data.frame(
  country_name = VDEM$country_name,
  COWcode = VDEM$COWcode,
  regime_type = VDEM$v2x_regime_amb, # General Regime Type Variable
  electoral_demo = VDEM$v2x_polyarchy, # Electoral democracy index
  presidentialism = VDEM$v2xnp_pres, # Presidentialism Index
  human_rights = VDEM$v2x_civlib, # Civil liberty Index
  transparency = VDEM$v2x_freexp_altinf, # Freedom of Expression
  civil_society_participation = VDEM$v2x_cspart, 
  judicial_constraints = VDEM$v2x_jucon,
  year = VDEM$year
)

VDEM_simple$regime_type = ifelse(VDEM_simple$regime_type <= 4, 0, 1)

VDEM_simple$gwncode = countrycode(VDEM_simple$COWcode, origin = "cown", destination = "gwn")

VDEM_simple$gwncode[VDEM_simple$COWcode == 260] = 260  # Germany
VDEM_simple$gwncode[VDEM_simple$COWcode == 271] = 260  # Wuerttemburg to Germany
VDEM_simple$gwncode[VDEM_simple$COWcode == 273] = 260  # Hesse-Kassel to Germany
VDEM_simple$gwncode[VDEM_simple$COWcode == 275] = 260  # Hesse-Darmstadt to Germany
VDEM_simple$gwncode[VDEM_simple$COWcode == 403] = 403  # Sao Tome and Principe 
VDEM_simple$gwncode[VDEM_simple$COWcode == 591] = 591  # Seychells
VDEM_simple$gwncode[VDEM_simple$COWcode == 679] = 678  # Yemen
VDEM_simple$gwncode[VDEM_simple$COWcode == 730] = 732  # South Korea
VDEM_simple$gwncode[VDEM_simple$COWcode == 817] = 816  # Republic Vietnam to Vietnam
VDEM_simple$gwncode[VDEM_simple$COWcode == 935] = 935  # Vanuatu
# I find that there are some countries which do not have COWcode at all. How can we solve this problem?

VDEM_simple$cracid = VDEM_simple$gwncode
VDEM_simple$gwncode = NULL
```

```{r, echo = F}
ICB_years = ICBdy %>%
  dplyr::select(crisno, year) %>%
  distinct() 
# extract basic time information from ICB-dyadic level data
ICBint_step1 = left_join(ICB_int, ICB_years, by = "crisno")
# combine the year infromation with the ICB_int level data
ICBint_step1 = ICBint_step1[ICBint_step1$intervener_category_id != 1,]
# Remove all the crisis actors
```

```{r, echo = F}
ICBint_step2 = left_join(ICBint_step1,VDEM_simple,by = c("cracid","year"))

ICBint_step2 = ICBint_step2 %>%
  group_by(crisno, cracid) %>%
  filter(year == min(year)) %>%  
  ungroup()


ICBint_step2 = ICBint_step2[!ICBint_step2$actor %in% c("SEATO", "Sihanouk", "UN", "Qaddhafi", "Sadat", "Arab League", "OAS", "Vietcong"), ]
```

```{r, echo = F}
ICB_outcome = data.frame(
  crisno = ICB1$crisno,
  forout = ICB1$forout, # a factor variable, with 1 = formal agreement, 2 = semi-formal agreement, 3 = tacit understanding, 4 = unilateral act, 5 = imposed agreement, 6 = other, 7 = crisis faded
  outesr = ICB1$outesr, # outcome on the tension level
  crismg = ICB1$crismg, 
  protrac = ICB1$protrac,
  gravcr = ICB1$gravcr)

ICB_outcome$protrac = ifelse(ICB_outcome$protrac == 1, 0, 1)
ICB_outcome$gravcr = ifelse(ICB_outcome$gravcr == 5|ICB_outcome$gravcr == 6, 1, 0)
ICB_outcome$forout = ifelse(ICB_outcome$forout == 1|ICB_outcome$forout == 2|ICB_outcome$forout == 3,1,0) # code this variable as a binary variable, the standard of assigning a 1 is whether this conflict ends by mutually-agreed treaties
ICB_outcome$outesr = ifelse(ICB_outcome$outesr == 1,0,
                           ifelse(ICB_outcome$outesr == 2,1,NA))
# Escalation has been assigned a 0. Reduction is assigned a 1. Recent crises are regarded as NA.
ICB_outcome$crismg = ifelse(ICB_outcome$crismg==1|ICB_outcome$crismg==2|ICB_outcome$crismg==3|ICB_outcome$crismg==4|ICB_outcome$crismg==5|ICB_outcome$crismg==6,0,1)
# Violent crisis management will be assigned a 1, other values will be assigned a 0.

ICBint_step3 = left_join(
  ICBint_step2,
  ICB_outcome,
  by = "crisno"
) %>%
  group_by(crisno) %>%
  mutate(
    US_involvement = as.integer(any(cracid == 2, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() # create a variable to indicated the effect of the U.S.
```

Dyadic level and crisis-actor level data

```{r, echo = F}
ICBdy_clean = ICBdy %>%
  group_by(crdynum) %>% 
  filter(year == min(year))
ICBdy_clean$ongoing = NULL 

select = c("actnuma","actnumb","trgmody","trgdady","trmyrdy","trmmody","trmdady","year")
ICBdy_clean = ICBdy_clean[, !(names(ICBdy_clean) %in% select)]


ICBdy_step1 = left_join(ICBdy_clean, ICBint_step3, by = c("crisno"))
ICBdy_step1$crisis_name = NULL
ICBdy_step1$year = NULL
ICBdy_step1$cowcode = ICBdy_step1$COWcode
ICBdy_step1$gwncode = ICBdy_step1$cracid
ICBdy_step1$cracid = NULL
ICBdy_step1$COWcode = NULL
```

Bring in the polity information of crisis actors (Source of data: VDEM)

```{r, echo = F}
VDEM_simple2 = data.frame(
  year = VDEM_simple$year,
  cracid = VDEM_simple$cracid,
  regime_type = VDEM_simple$regime_type
)

ICBdy_step2 = left_join(ICBdy_step1, VDEM_simple2, by = c("statea" = "cracid", "trgyrdy" = "year")) 

colnames(ICBdy_step2)[colnames(ICBdy_step2) == "regime_type.y"] = "regime_type_a"
colnames(ICBdy_step2)[colnames(ICBdy_step2) == "regime_type.x"] = "regime_type_int"


ICBdy_step3 = left_join(ICBdy_step2, VDEM_simple2, by = c("stateb" = "cracid", "trgyrdy" = "year")) 

colnames(ICBdy_step3)[colnames(ICBdy_step3) == "regime_type"] = "regime_type_b"

ICBdy_step3$regime_type_difference = ifelse(ICBdy_step3$regime_type_a == 0 & ICBdy_step3$regime_type_b == 0, 1,
                               ifelse(ICBdy_step3$regime_type_a == 1 & ICBdy_step3$regime_type_b == 0, 2,
                                      ifelse(ICBdy_step3$regime_type_a == 0 & ICBdy_step3$regime_type_b == 1, 2, 3)))
# Both are autocracies --> 1, Auto vs. Demo --> 2, Both are democracies --> 3
ICBdy_step3$regime_type_difference = factor(ICBdy_step3$regime_type_difference)
```

Alliance (Source of data: COW)

```{r, echo = F}
alliance_simple = data.frame(
  ccode1 = alliance$ccode1,
  ccode2 = alliance$ccode2,
  year = alliance$year
)

alliance_simple$gwncode1 = countrycode(alliance_simple$ccode1, origin = "cown", destination = "gwn")
alliance_simple$gwncode2 = countrycode(alliance_simple$ccode2, origin = "cown", destination = "gwn")

alliance_simple$gwncode1[alliance_simple$ccode1 == 260] = 260  # Germany
alliance_simple$gwncode1[alliance_simple$ccode1 == 271] = 260  # Wuerttemburg to Germany
alliance_simple$gwncode1[alliance_simple$ccode1 == 273] = 260  # Hesse-Kassel to Germany
alliance_simple$gwncode1[alliance_simple$ccode1 == 275] = 260  # Hesse-Darmstadt to Germany
alliance_simple$gwncode1[alliance_simple$ccode1 == 403] = 403  # Sao Tome and Principe 
alliance_simple$gwncode1[alliance_simple$ccode1 == 679] = 678  # Yemen
alliance_simple$gwncode1[alliance_simple$ccode1 == 730] = 732  # South Korea

alliance_simple$gwncode2[alliance_simple$ccode2 == 260] = 260  # Germany
alliance_simple$gwncode2[alliance_simple$ccode2 == 271] = 260  # Wuerttemburg to Germany
alliance_simple$gwncode2[alliance_simple$ccode2 == 273] = 260  # Hesse-Kassel to Germany
alliance_simple$gwncode2[alliance_simple$ccode2 == 275] = 260  # Hesse-Darmstadt to Germany
alliance_simple$gwncode2[alliance_simple$ccode2 == 679] = 678  # Yemen
alliance_simple$gwncode2[alliance_simple$ccode2 == 817] = 816  # Republic Vietnam to Vietnam

alliance_simple$alliance = 1
alliance_simple$ccode1 = NULL
alliance_simple$ccode2 = NULL

ICBdy_step4 = left_join(ICBdy_step3, alliance_simple, by = c("statea" = "gwncode1","gwncode" = "gwncode2", "trgyrdy" = "year"))
colnames(ICBdy_step4)[colnames(ICBdy_step4) == "alliance"] = "alliancea1"

ICBdy_step4 = ICBdy_step4[!duplicated(ICBdy_step4), ]

ICBdy_step5 = left_join(ICBdy_step4, alliance_simple, by = c("statea" = "gwncode2","gwncode" = "gwncode1", "trgyrdy" = "year"))
colnames(ICBdy_step5)[colnames(ICBdy_step5) == "alliance"] = "alliancea2"

ICBdy_step5 = ICBdy_step5[!duplicated(ICBdy_step5), ]

ICBdy_step6 = left_join(ICBdy_step5, alliance_simple, by = c("stateb" = "gwncode1","gwncode" = "gwncode2", "trgyrdy" = "year"))
colnames(ICBdy_step6)[colnames(ICBdy_step6) == "alliance"] = "allianceb1"

ICBdy_step6 = ICBdy_step6[!duplicated(ICBdy_step6), ]

ICBdy_step7 = left_join(ICBdy_step6, alliance_simple, by = c("stateb" = "gwncode2","gwncode" = "gwncode1", "trgyrdy" = "year"))
colnames(ICBdy_step7)[colnames(ICBdy_step7) == "alliance"] = "allianceb2"

ICBdy_step7 = ICBdy_step7[!duplicated(ICBdy_step7), ]

ICBdy_step7$alliancea1 = ifelse(is.na(ICBdy_step7$alliancea1), 0, ICBdy_step7$alliancea1)
ICBdy_step7$alliancea2 = ifelse(is.na(ICBdy_step7$alliancea2), 0, ICBdy_step7$alliancea2)

ICBdy_step7$alliancea = ifelse(ICBdy_step7$alliancea1 == 1|ICBdy_step7$alliancea2 == 1, 1, 0)

ICBdy_step7$allianceb1 = ifelse(is.na(ICBdy_step7$allianceb1), 0, ICBdy_step7$allianceb1)
ICBdy_step7$allianceb2 = ifelse(is.na(ICBdy_step7$allianceb2), 0, ICBdy_step7$allianceb2)

ICBdy_step7$allianceb = ifelse(ICBdy_step7$allianceb1 == 1|ICBdy_step7$allianceb2 == 1, 1, 0)

ICBdy_step7$ties_to_both_sides = ifelse(ICBdy_step7$alliancea == 1 & ICBdy_step7$allianceb == 1, 1, 0)

ICBdy_step7$alliance = ifelse((ICBdy_step7$alliancea == 1 | ICBdy_step7$allianceb == 1) & ICBdy_step7$ties_to_both_sides == 0, 1, 0)

ICBdy_step7$alliancea1 = NULL
ICBdy_step7$alliancea2 = NULL
ICBdy_step7$allianceb1 = NULL
ICBdy_step7$allianceb2 = NULL
ICBdy_step7$alliancea = NULL
ICBdy_step7$allianceb = NULL
```

Military Expenditure (Source of data: COW)

```{r, echo = F}
military_simple = data.frame(
  ccode = military$ccode,
  year = military$year,
  milex = military$milex, # expenditure

  cinc = military$cinc # Composite Index of National Capabilities 
)

military_simple$gwncode = countrycode(military_simple$ccode, origin = "cown", destination = "gwn")

military_simple$gwncode[military_simple$ccode == 260] = 260  # Germany
military_simple$gwncode[military_simple$ccode == 271] = 260  # Wuerttemburg to Germany
military_simple$gwncode[military_simple$ccode == 273] = 260  # Hesse-Kassel to Germany
military_simple$gwncode[military_simple$ccode == 275] = 260  # Hesse-Darmstadt to Germany
military_simple$gwncode[military_simple$ccode == 403] = 403  # Sao Tome and Principe 
military_simple$gwncode[military_simple$ccode == 591] = 591  # Seychells
military_simple$gwncode[military_simple$ccode == 679] = 678  # Yemen
military_simple$gwncode[military_simple$ccode == 730] = 732  # South Korea

military_simple$gwncode[military_simple$ccode == 935] = 935  # Vanuatu

ICBdy_step8 = left_join(ICBdy_step7, military_simple, by = c("trgyrdy" = "year", "statea" = "gwncode"))

ICBdy_step8 = ICBdy_step8[!duplicated(ICBdy_step8[,1:(ncol(ICBdy_step8) - 3)]), ]

colnames(ICBdy_step9)[colnames(ICBdy_step9) == "milex"] = "military_expenditure_b"
colnames(ICBdy_step9)[colnames(ICBdy_step9) == "milper"] = "military_personnel_b"
colnames(ICBdy_step9)[colnames(ICBdy_step9) == "cinc"] = "state_capacity_b"

ICBdy_step9$military_personnel_b = ifelse(ICBdy_step9$military_personnel_b == -9, NA, ICBdy_step9$military_personnel_b)

ICBdy_step10 = left_join(ICBdy_step9, military_simple, by = c("trgyrdy" = "year", "gwncode"))

ICBdy_step10 = ICBdy_step10[!duplicated(ICBdy_step10), ]

cols_to_check = names(ICBdy_step10)[1:(ncol(ICBdy_step8) - 3)]

ICBdy_step10 = ICBdy_step10[!duplicated(ICBdy_step10[, cols_to_check]), ]

ICBdy_step10$milex = ifelse(ICBdy_step10$milex == -9, NA, ICBdy_step10$milex)
ICBdy_step10$milper = ifelse(ICBdy_step10$milper == -9, NA, ICBdy_step10$milper)

colnames(ICBdy_step10)[colnames(ICBdy_step10) == "milex"] = "military_expenditure_int" 
colnames(ICBdy_step10)[colnames(ICBdy_step10) == "milper"] = "military_personnel_int"
colnames(ICBdy_step10)[colnames(ICBdy_step10) == "cinc"] = "state_capacity_int"
```

```{r, echo = F}
contdird$gwncode1 = countrycode(contdird$state1no, origin = "cown", destination = "gwn")

contdird$gwncode1[contdird$state1no == 260] = 260  # Germany
contdird$gwncode1[contdird$state1no == 271] = 260  # Wuerttemburg to Germany
contdird$gwncode1[contdird$state1no == 273] = 260  # Hesse-Kassel to Germany
contdird$gwncode1[contdird$state1no == 275] = 260  # Hesse-Darmstadt to Germany
contdird$gwncode1[contdird$state1no == 403] = 403  # Sao Tome and Principe 
contdird$gwncode1[contdird$state1no == 591] = 591  # Seychells
contdird$gwncode1[contdird$state1no == 679] = 678  # Yemen
contdird$gwncode1[contdird$state1no == 730] = 732  # South Korea
contdird$gwncode1[contdird$state1no == 817] = 816  # Republic Vietnam to Vietnam
contdird$gwncode1[contdird$state1no == 935] = 935  # Vanuatu

contdird$gwncode2 = countrycode(contdird$state2no, origin = "cown", destination = "gwn")

contdird$gwncode2[contdird$state2no == 260] = 260  # Germany
contdird$gwncode2[contdird$state2no == 271] = 260  # Wuerttemburg to Germany
contdird$gwncode2[contdird$state2no == 273] = 260  # Hesse-Kassel to Germany
contdird$gwncode2[contdird$state2no == 275] = 260  # Hesse-Darmstadt to Germany
contdird$gwncode2[contdird$state2no == 403] = 403  # Sao Tome and Principe 
contdird$gwncode2[contdird$state2no == 591] = 591  # Seychells
contdird$gwncode2[contdird$state2no == 679] = 678  # Yemen
contdird$gwncode2[contdird$state2no == 730] = 732  # South Korea
contdird$gwncode2[contdird$state2no == 817] = 816  # Republic Vietnam to Vietnam
contdird$gwncode2[contdird$state2no == 935] = 935  # Vanuatu

contdird$state1no = NULL
contdird$state2no = NULL
contdird$conttype = 1

ICBdy_step11 = left_join(ICBdy_step10, contdird, by = c("statea" = "gwncode1","gwncode" = "gwncode2", "trgyrdy" = "year"))

ICBdy_step11 = ICBdy_step11[!duplicated(ICBdy_step11), ]

ICBdy_step12 = left_join(ICBdy_step11, contdird, by = c("stateb" = "gwncode1","gwncode" = "gwncode2", "trgyrdy" = "year"))

ICBdy_step12 = ICBdy_step12[!duplicated(ICBdy_step12), ]

ICBdy_step13 = left_join(ICBdy_step12, contdird, by = c("gwncode" = "gwncode1","statea" = "gwncode2", "trgyrdy" = "year"))

ICBdy_step13 = ICBdy_step13[!duplicated(ICBdy_step13), ]

ICBdy_step14 = left_join(ICBdy_step13, contdird, by = c("gwncode" = "gwncode1","stateb" = "gwncode2", "trgyrdy" = "year"))

ICBdy_step14 = ICBdy_step14[!duplicated(ICBdy_step14), ]

ICBdy_step14$contiguous_intervener = ifelse(ICBdy_step14$conttype.x == 1|ICBdy_step14$conttype.y == 1|ICBdy_step14$conttype.x.x == 1|ICBdy_step14$conttype.y.y == 1, 1, 0)

ICBdy_step14$contiguous_intervener = ifelse(is.na(ICBdy_step14$contiguous_intervener) == 1, 0, ICBdy_step14$contiguous_intervener)
# In this regard, the contiguous_intervener variable implies whether the intervening state and at least one of the crisis actors are geographically contiguous_countryiguous (including both land neighbor and maritime neighbor).
ICBdy_step14[,c("conttype.x","conttype.y","conttype.x.x","conttype.y.y")] = NULL

ICBdy_step15 = left_join(ICBdy_step14, contdird, by = c("statea" = "gwncode1","stateb" = "gwncode2", "trgyrdy" = "year"))

ICBdy_step15 = ICBdy_step15[!duplicated(ICBdy_step15), ]

names(ICBdy_step15)[names(ICBdy_step15) == "conttype"] = "contiguous_actors"
```

rule out all military interventions

```{r, echo = F}
ICBdy_step16 = ICBdy_step15[ICBdy_step15$intervener_category_id != 5,]

ICBdy_step15_simple = ICBdy_step15 %>% 
  group_by(crdynum) %>%
  summarise(milint = if_else(any(intervener_category_id == 5), 1 , 0))
```

```{r, echo = F}
ICB_one_observation = ICBdy_step16 %>%
  group_by(crdynum) %>%
  summarise(
    crisno = first(crisno),
    crisname = first(crisname),
    statea = first(statea),
    namea = first(namea),
    stateb = first(stateb),
    nameb = first(nameb),
    trgyrdy = first(trgyrdy),
    regime_type_int = ifelse(any(regime_type_int > 0), 1, 0),
    electoral_demo  = mean(electoral_demo, na.rm = TRUE),
    presidentialism = mean(presidentialism, na.rm = TRUE),
    human_rights = mean(human_rights, na.rm = TRUE),
    transparency = mean(transparency, na.rm = TRUE),
    judicial_constraints = mean(judicial_constraints, na.rm = TRUE),
    civil_society_participation = mean(civil_society_participation, na.rm = TRUE),
    forout = if_else(any(forout == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0),
    outesr = if_else(any(outesr == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0),
    crismg = if_else(any(crismg == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0),
    protrac = if_else(any(protrac == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0),
    gravcr = if_else(any(gravcr == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0),
    regime_type_a = first(regime_type_a),
    regime_type_b = first(regime_type_b),
    regime_type_difference = first(regime_type_difference),
    coldwar = first(coldwar),
    alliance = if_else(any(alliance == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0),
    ties_to_both_sides = if_else(any(ties_to_both_sides == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0),
    military_expenditure_a = first(military_expenditure_a),
    military_personnel_a = first(military_personnel_a),
    state_capacity_a = first(state_capacity_a),
    military_expenditure_b = first(military_expenditure_b),
    military_personnel_b = first(military_personnel_b),
    state_capacity_b = first(state_capacity_b),
    military_expenditure_int = mean(military_expenditure_int),
    military_personnel_int = mean(military_personnel_int),
    state_capacity_int = mean(state_capacity_int),
    contiguous_intervener = if_else(any(contiguous_intervener == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0),
    contiguous_actors = if_else(any(contiguous_actors == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0),
    human_rights = mean(human_rights),
    US_involvement = mean(US_involvement)
  )

ICB_one_observation2 = left_join(ICB_one_observation, ICBdy_step15_simple, by = "crdynum")
```

Relative Strength
```{r, echo = F}
ICB_one_observation2$relative_power = 2*abs((ICB_one_observation2$military_expenditure_a/(ICB_one_observation2$military_expenditure_a+ICB_one_observation2$military_expenditure_b))-0.5)
```

```{r, echo = F}
write_csv(
  ICB_one_observation2,
  here("Cleaned Data", "ICB_oob.csv")
)
```
